result.reason: Section 2.1 reaches the fallback: the commitment is confined to the current 12-month term, may be reduced on 30 days' notice, and uses a shortfall true-up without penalties or acceleration. The changes are targeted and otherwise preserve the agreement's commercial scope. Drafting quality is reduced because §12.3 still states that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, creating an unresolved inconsistency that the margin comment identifies but the operative language does not fix.
